sentences.text: The petitioner had approached the learned Additional Sessions Judge- cum-Special Judge, Malkangiri, I/c, in G.R. (Special) No.26 of 2024 praying for grant of bail.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge- cum-Special Judge, Malkangiri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned Court below vide its order dated 25.04.2024 rejected the bail application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. praying for enlargement on bail.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner, submits that, except the present bail application, no other bail application of the petitioner is pending in any other Court relating to the aforesaid F.I.R.
3.

The prosecution case as per the F.I.R. is that, the complainant reported at Malkangiri P.S. alleging that, the present petitioner had captured the nude photographs/video of his daughter and asked for physical relationship.
The petitioner also threatened the victim to make viral her nude photographs/video, if she will not comply his demand.

Hence, the F.I.R.

1 4.
The victim is stated to be 17 years of age.

Her statement was recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.
P.C.
She, in her statement, has stated that, in the month of October, 2023, the petitioner had sexually exploited her and taken her photographs.
They have been keeping relationship since then.

Again in the month of March, 2024, the petitioner, by showing the photographs taken earlier,
insisted the victim to have sexual intercourse with her.
Therefore, on 10.04.2024, the F.I.R. has been registered against the petitioner.
5. I have perused the evidence on record, which form part of the charge sheet and also seen the photographs, which have been seized by the Police.
The photographs, which have been seized by the Police are not explicit in nature.
6. The petitioner is 19 years of age.
It appears from the evidence on record that, the petitioner, who is 19 years of age, was one year senior to the victim, who is 17 years of age.
They were in relationship.

7. From the evidence collected by the prosecution, which form part of the charge sheet, the nature of accusation and the age of both the victim (17 years) and the accused (19 years), it can be inferred that this is neither a case of perpetration of sexual exploitation or abuse nor emotional obtrude caused to the vulnerable minor girl, rather it's an adolescence love affair, which has gone sour.
Therefore, the accused is entitled to bail.
8. The F.I.R. was registered on 10.04.2024.

The petitioner has been in custody since 11.04.2024.
9.

Regard being had to the nature of the accusation and the period of custody of the petitioner, i.e.,
since 11.04.2024, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
10.

In the event the petitioner is found to be wanted for violation of any of the bail conditions imposed by this Court or the trial Court even on a single occasion, the prosecution is at liberty to move appropriate application before the Court below for cancellation of the concession of bail granted by this Court.
If such application is filed, the trial Court should decide the application on its own merit.

11. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge Subhasis Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
